top_news.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
top_news.dek: Google has released Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber, focusing on improved reasoning and coding capabilities for agentic and security-focused workflows.
top_news.brief: The 3.8 Flash series arrives just three weeks after the 3.7 release, marking a rapid iteration cycle for Google's lightweight model family. The update emphasizes enhanced reasoning and coding performance while maintaining the low-latency characteristics required for agentic applications. The new Flash Cyber variant is specifically optimized for cybersecurity tasks.
top_news.image_alt: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber branding graphic

top_news.title: SpeakPay: Domain-Adaptive LoRA Fine-Tuning of Whisper for Low-Resource Nepali Financial Speech Recognition
top_news.dek: SpeakPay uses LoRA fine-tuning on Whisper to improve Nepali financial speech recognition for low-resource environments.
top_news.brief: Researchers introduced NepFinSpeech-403, a dataset of 403 Nepali financial voice commands, to address accessibility gaps in mobile payments. By fine-tuning Whisper large-v2 with LoRA, the team significantly reduced the Word Error Rate compared to zero-shot baselines, enabling more reliable voice-first interactions for visually impaired users.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the LoRA fine-tuning process for the Whisper model on Nepali financial audio data.

top_news.title: Cohere’s Parse 5 Promises Efficient Multi-Modal Information Extraction From Complex Documents
top_news.dek: Cohere released Parse 5, a 2.3B parameter multimodal model for extracting structured data from complex documents.
top_news.brief: Parse 5 converts visually rich PDFs into clean Markdown while providing bounding box coordinates for visual grounding. Optimized for enterprise workloads, the model features an 8K-token context window and is designed to handle diverse document types like financial reports and scientific papers.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual visualization of a PDF document being parsed into structured Markdown and bounding box data.

top_news.title: Sandbox SDK - Run Cursor Cloud Agents on Cloudflare via self-hosted machines
top_news.dek: Cursor Cloud Agents can now run on Cloudflare infrastructure using self-hosted machine pools.
top_news.brief: Developers can execute agent sessions within isolated Cloudflare Containers. While Cursor manages the agent loop, inference, and planning, the Cloudflare integration handles file operations, command execution, and repository management, providing users with greater control over their infrastructure.
top_news.image_alt: Screenshot of the Cursor Cloud Agents environment selector showing the cloudflare-pool configuration.

top_news.title: Qwen Developers Open-Sources zg (zvec-grep): A Local-First Search Layer Unifying ripgrep, BM25, and Vector Search
top_news.dek: The open-source 'zg' tool unifies ripgrep, BM25, and vector search into a single interface for coding agents.
top_news.brief: Developed by the Qwen team, zg (zvec-grep) streamlines search by allowing agents to transition from plain-language queries to exact line spans without switching tools. It features a small MCP surface and an on-device embedding catalog, reducing the token and latency costs typically associated with multi-step search workflows.
top_news.image_alt: Architecture diagram showing the integration of ripgrep, BM25, and vector search within the zg interface.

primary.summary: Grounded question answering systems should answer only when the supplied evidence supports the answer. primary.title: Meet Switchyard: A Rust Proxy and Library That Routes and Translates LLM Traffic Across OpenAI and Anthropic APIs
primary.summary: NVIDIA has released Switchyard, an Apache-2.0 Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic. It decodes requests into provider-neutral types, routes them with passthrough, random, LLM-classifier, or stage-router algorithms, and translates responses back into the client's format, so Claude Code or Codex CLI can run against vLLM, NIM, or Ollama unchanged.
